name: 360 Community Management
subject: How 360 Community Management chases certificates of insurance
text:
Hello,

I have you down as a HOA / community association management in San
Diego, California, which is why this is going to you rather than to a
list.

I am building Certly: it reads an ACORD 25 certificate of insurance,
pulls out the limits, the dates and the endorsements, and tells you what
is missing or expiring before somebody walks on site without cover.

Being straight with you: Certly is new, it has no track record I can
point at, and I am not going to invent one.

What would help me is fifteen minutes on how you handle it today: who
chases the renewals, what you do when a certificate arrives short, and
what you would refuse to change. If that is not worth your time, a no
closes it and I will not chase.

--
Certly, a TheVillage company
